remarks: Welcome to 29 Windgate a spacious Colonial tucked away on a quiet, cul-de-sac in Orchard Park. Beautiful curb appeal, mature landscaping, a double-wide concrete driveway & covered front porch set the tone for this impressive home offering an abundance of living & storage space. The welcoming foyer opens to a large formal living room & dining room, perfect for entertaining. The updated kitchen features granite countertops, cherry cabinetry, pull-out drawers, ceramic tile backsplash & flooring, an island with custom pendant lighting, stainless steel appliances, & a built-in bar with wine rack. The kitchen flows into a comfortable family room featuring skylights, a wood-burning fireplace & access to the rear covered patio. A versatile additional room off the dining room provides even more living space & offers excellent potential as a home office, playroom, guest quarters or first-floor primary suite. This space includes generous closet storage, private backyard access & a half bath/laundry room. A separate half bath is conveniently located off the main entry. Upstairs, the spacious primary suite is extraordinary, offering two deep closets & a private hallway lined with an entire wall of built-in storage leading to the beautiful ensuite bath The ensuite features heated ceramic tile flooring, quartz countertops, double sinks, a glass walk-in shower with dual showerheads & a separate toilet area Two additional spacious bedrooms offer excellent closet space, while a full hallway bath conveniently serves the second floor. The full basement provides abundant additional storage along with a second set of laundry hookups Drainage improvements were completed by Frank's in 2026 and include a transferable warranty Additional highlights include 200-amp electric central air a whole-house humidifier & Generac whole-house generator. Step outside to a truly park-like setting designed for relaxing & entertaining. Enjoy the covered patio, tiered pool deck, heated above-ground pool built-in fire pit multiple sheds & an impressive custom play area featuring a 7-person airplane teeter-totter. Mature trees provide wonderful privacy & create a backyard oasis with plenty of room to enjoy
